query:
INSERT INTO job_events (job_id, run_number, attempt, event_type, payload)
         VALUES (
            $1,
            $2,
            $3,
            'DEAD_LETTERED',
            jsonb_build_object(
                'kind', 'LEASE_EXPIRED',
                'error_code', 'job.lease_expired',
                'started_without_renewal_heartbeat', $4::bool
            )
         )
